tweet_summary: Quoting a clip of Nadhim Zahawi announcing COVID vaccine-as-condition-of-entry rules, the poster claims the UK 'lost 20% of our care workers because of this creatures vax mandates'.
why_note_decision: The 20% figure is false and inflated by ~5x. The best empirical study (University of Nottingham, Management Science 2023) found the care-home vaccine mandate caused a NET reduction of about 3-4% of staff (14,000-19,000 of ~470,000) in English elderly care homes -- not 20%. A note is warranted to correct the inflated statistic. The original note states the correct figure and is substantively accurate; it was likely rated not-helpful for tone/context reasons rather than for being wrong.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the note corrects the '20%' figure with the actual evidence: the UK care-home COVID vaccine mandate caused roughly a 3-4% NET staff reduction (~14,000-19,000 workers out of ~470,000), per the University of Nottingham / Management Science (2023) study -- i.e. about a fifth of the claimed loss, not 20% of the workforce. The note MUST cite a credible source (Nottingham study / The Conversation summary). FAIL if it omits the correct ~3-4% figure, repeats or concedes the 20% claim, or is purely argumentative. Avoid the original's risk of reading as one-sided -- state the number plainly and neutrally.
reference_note: The claim that 20% of care workers were lost is wrong. The English care-home COVID vaccine mandate caused a net reduction of about 3-4% of staff (roughly 14,000-19,000 of ~470,000), per University of Nottingham research published in Management Science (2023). https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/news/mandatory-covid-vaccines-care-home-workers-reduction-in-staff https://theconversation.com/the-covid-vaccine-mandate-in-english-care-homes-led-to-fewer-staff-and-may-not-have-reduced-resident-deaths-203201

original_unhelpful_note.text: The UK's mandatory COVID vaccine policy for care home workers led to a net loss of 3-4% of staff (14,000-19,000 workers out of ~470,000), not 20%. https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/news/mandatory-covid-vaccines-care-home-workers-reduction-in-staff https://theconversation.com/the-covid-vaccine-mandate-in-english-care-homes-led-to-fewer-staff-and-may-not-have-reduced-resident-deaths-203201
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: Substantively correct and well sourced; rated not-helpful most likely on tone/'note-not-needed' grounds in a hostile partisan thread, and arguably for not engaging the emotional framing. The core numeric correction is accurate.

fact_check.notes: Net reduction ~3-4% (14,000-19,000) in elderly care homes. A gross figure of 28,000-41,000 fewer unvaccinated staff vs counterfactual exists, but the NET workforce reduction was ~4%. Either way, '20%' is unsupported and roughly 5x too high.

importance.lens_rationale: Health/vaccine-policy misinformation to 226k-follower account; inflated harm claims feed anti-vaccine narratives, a real public-health cost.
